caption: The drawing features a detailed black line illustration of a single ornate chair, shown from three different perspectives: front view, side view, and partial top armrest detail. The chair has a decorative backrest with flowing curves, symmetrical scrollwork, and an urn-shaped central splat. The armrests are straight with rounded ends, and the front legs are cabriole-style, featuring carved shell motifs at the knees and terminating in scroll feet. The seat is rectangular and bordered with a simple line. The side view highlights the curve of the armrest and the shape of the leg, displaying a scroll and leaf design on the knee area. The drawing is rendered on an off-white or beige background, with black ink used to depict the contours and details of the chair. In the lower left corner, there is a scale indication reading “SCALE – ONE FOOT – TWO INCHES.” In the lower right corner, there is a signature "Tivingstone."
title: Armchair
